rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: direct runtime React import and inline async function only. Inner async work, synchronous setup, custom hooks, type-only imports, binding escapes and shadows stay silent. TypeScript or lint may already reject this code.

sources.claim: Effect setup may return cleanup or nothing; an async function returns a Promise. Missing dependencies alone do not establish an infinite loop.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.

rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: direct await of imported callback pipeline/readFile/writeFile with an inline function callback and supported arity. Promises imports, callback-only calls, wrappers, type imports, shadows, spreads and chained results stay unresolved or silent. A deliberately thenable custom pipeline destination needs review.

sources.claim: Callback pipeline returns the destination; the stream/promises API supplies completion promises.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.
Callback file APIs do not return the Promise for completion; the fs/promises API supplies the awaited result.

rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: one SQL file with supported explicit BEGIN or START TRANSACTION and concurrent CREATE/DROP INDEX or REINDEX INDEX/TABLE before completion. Other REINDEX forms/options remain unresolved. Comments, strings, dollar bodies, committed transactions and non-concurrent forms stay silent. Dialect, runner and cross-file state are not resolved.

sources.claim: PostgreSQL CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.
PostgreSQL concurrent DROP INDEX cannot execute in a transaction block; ordinary DROP INDEX can.
PostgreSQL concurrent REINDEX cannot execute in a transaction block; other REINDEX restrictions depend on the object type.

adversarial.rationale: Commented transaction text has no DDL effect.
A dollar-quoted body does not begin a top-level transaction.
Nested PostgreSQL comments keep transaction-looking text outside executable SQL.
Whitespace and comments preserve concurrent DDL.
Transaction and DDL text inside a dollar literal are data, not commands.
Nested comments cannot start a transaction or rebuild a persistent index.
A comment between keywords does not remove the concurrent transaction restriction.

rules.false_positive_analysis: Advisory: single SQL-language SELECT body, explicit pg_temp-first path and bare FROM relation only. Invoker functions, qualified relations, temp-last or empty paths, procedural bodies, CTEs, dynamic settings, escaped bodies and multiple statements stay unresolved or silent. Files with ALTER/DROP FUNCTION need lifecycle analysis and stay silent for this rule. Deliberately reading temporary relations may be intended.

sources.claim: SECURITY DEFINER functions need safe name resolution: pg_temp should follow trusted schemas, and protected relations should be qualified.
Taxonomy for the local API/configuration boundary, not execution or exploitability evidence.
